messages:
maya_devex: Quick async check-in — yesterday: merged the M1 build fix for sample-app; updated Dockerfile and added a tiny CI shim.

Blockers: embeddings E2E flaky (timeouts in embeddings/e2e.py:78). I tried increasing timeouts locally but failing on CI.

Today: cut a quickstart patch, pinging SDK to publish a rc and asking docs to update env var names. PTAL: https://github.com/redwood-inference/samples/pull/458

chad_platform: Saw the PR, left a comment on the Dockerfile about using multi-stage build. Also noticed staging CI failing on node 18 matrix — trying `npm ci --legacy-peer-deps` to unblock.

samira_docs: Quick Q on env var: REDWOOD_API_KEY vs RW_API_KEY — prefer REDWOOD_API_KEY for clarity unless SDK folks object. I can open the docs PR after the samples merge.

lee_sdk: Working on python SDK 0.9.2-rc.1. Need validation for streaming chunk handling. Can someone add a minimal streaming example in samples/streaming? cc @maya_devex

maya_devex: Yes — please add a streaming sample. Use this example snippet to exercise chunking:
```bash
export REDWOOD_API_KEY="..."
python examples/streaming.py --model=redwood-small
```
I also added `samples/ci/test_runner.sh` to exercise M1 image locally.

chad_platform: Pinging eng-infra about macOS runners. @deploy-bot do we have an ETA on the macOS pool upgrade?

deploy-bot: Scheduled macOS runner pool upgrade at 2026-06-12 02:00 UTC — no expected downtime. :robot_face:

samira_docs: Noted. I'll use triple-backtick code blocks per style guide and include a one-line command example in the quickstart.

lee_sdk: Draft SDK PR pushed: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/102 — added integration test using samples/streaming.py with mocked responses. Needs CI review from @chad_platform.

maya_devex: Blocker detail — embedding e2e fails with timeout stack (embeddings/e2e.py:78). Might be related to batching change merged yesterday. Anyone seen similar behavior?

chad_platform: I'll check the batching config that landed. If it's quick I'll revert; otherwise will add a canary rollout to dedicated to avoid impacting prod.

lee_sdk: LGTM for REDWOOD_API_KEY variable name.

samira_docs: I'll author the docs PR once the samples merge. Will add a troubleshooting section for embedding timeouts recommending timeout bump to 45s.

maya_devex: Action items: chad -> investigate/revert or canary; lee -> review CI changes + SDK PR; samira -> docs PR after merge; maya -> keep watching embed tests and post an update in ~2 hrs. Thanks :thumbsup:

chad_platform: ack

lee_sdk: ack

samira_docs: thanks! :sparkles:
